interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation.declared_null: Neither ppo_ree_latent nor ppo_raw_obs clears the 1.0 competence floor (strict majority of seeds) at hazard-free D3 under the W3_survival_zeroed (consumption-only, imported verbatim from V3-EXQ-808) objective -> policy_learning_isolated_after_objective_correction. The failure can no longer be attributed to a survival-dominated objective -- deleted BY CONSTRUCTION, not merely by measurement -- so it isolates policy-learning inadequacy (or a deeper obstruction) as the surviving candidate explanation. This does NOT prove H-policy-learning outright; it closes the objective-misspecification confound on the POLICY axis specifically. H-objective-misspecification itself is adjudicated on the reward axis by its own dedicated probe, V3-EXQ-808, independently of this script's outcome.
interpretation.alternative_outcome_note: If ppo_ree_latent (or ppo_raw_obs) DOES clear the floor once the objective is corrected, that WEAKENS H-policy-learning and further corroborates H-objective-misspecification from the policy side: a real actor on the representation CAN forage; 737b's original null was an artifact of the mis-set reward, not of the learner or the representation.
interpretation.sibling_probe_independence_note: This probe and V3-EXQ-808 are independent legs on different design axes (policy vs reward) of the same GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio. Neither one's outcome is a precondition for the other; this script does not read or depend on V3-EXQ-808's manifest, and vice versa.
interpretation.preconditions_scope_note: No arm passed its gate, so every precondition is carried in interpretation.preconditions and the whole run is vacuous.

preconditions.name: ppo_ree_latent::zworld_encoder_trained_in_p0
preconditions.description: The z_world world_encoder must have moved during P0 (SD-070 warmup path). An unmoved encoder means ppo_ree_latent is PPO on a frozen random projection, which cannot license an 'isolates policy-learning' reading.
preconditions.control: worst-cell world_encoder_max_abs_delta over all seed warmups vs 1e-6

preconditions.name: ppo_ree_latent::d3_oracle_clears_floor
preconditions.description: The hazard-free D3 env must be floor-achievable with global information.
preconditions.control: greedy_oracle worst-seed mean resources/ep vs the 1.0 competence floor

preconditions.name: ppo_ree_latent::d3_local_view_greedy_clears_floor
preconditions.description: The env must be floor-achievable under the LEARNER'S OWN observability (the same 5x5 local field), not only under a privileged global oracle (the 732a confound). 738 measured 48.05 here.
preconditions.control: local_view_greedy worst-seed mean resources/ep vs the 1.0 competence floor

preconditions.name: ppo_ree_latent::consumption_share_dominates_under_correction
preconditions.description: At the W3_survival_zeroed weighting, the train-phase realised return must be overwhelmingly consumption (survival-linked terms are deleted by construction; harm is rare-to-absent at hazard-free D3). A below-floor reading signals an implementation defect, not a finding -- the objective correction did not actually land.
preconditions.control: worst-cell train-phase consumption_share for this arm at W3_survival_zeroed
